question: Does grader topology move the claim landscape, and by how much? dhk/minority-report#59 asserts a mechanism; this measures the effect.
method: Both passes re-grade the SAME preserved raw responses for r-2026-0813-03. No research model was dispatched. Checksums of all four raw files were verified against raw_responses.files on the run record before either pass ran.
group_classifier: alexandria.commission.classify_scores, imported unmodified; both passes classified by the same RFC-0005 precedence so the group counts are comparable

instrument.note: Identical to the instrument block on r-2026-0813-03. The prompt is alexandria.commission._grading_prompt imported from the installed package, not a reimplementation, so this pass is the production instrument.

No implementation of spec 3.1/3.2 exists. The extraction and per-model grading prompts were written for this ablation from the spec text. See the caveat in README.md: the delta therefore conflates topology with prompt wording.

validity_check.verdict: Pass A reproduces the published landscape within one novel claim, using the production prompt. The harness measures the instrument rather than an artefact of the harness.

confound_ruled_out.suspicion: Pass B returned exactly 100 claims, and both matrices in this run hold exactly 100 cells. If the extraction pass had enumerated matrix cells as claims, the delta would be an artefact.
confound_ruled_out.check: The extraction call was re-run alone and its 100 claim texts inspected.
confound_ruled_out.result: Refuted. The claims are substantive prose propositions. Occurrences across all 100 claim texts: 'matrix' 0, 'cell' 0, 'scale' 0, '×' 0.
